why_ai: Stocking, delivering and handing equipment, pipe and parts across a counter to contractors stays physical and relationship-based, though quoting, order entry and claims automate.
why_clarity: Orders, fill rates and claims are checkable, but commercial selections rarely learn their submittal or win outcome and counter identification is tacit.
why_digital: Schedules, orders and claims arrive digitally, but the product is physical goods delivered from local branches to contractors who buy by relationship.

why_ai: Dealers stay with the brand channel that has the matched system on the shelf on the peak day, a physical-inventory and relationship contest AI informs but does not replace.
why_clarity: In-stock rates on matched systems are measurable within days, but allocation and buying judgement are learned by season.
why_digital: Orders and availability are increasingly digital, while the deliverable is equipment on a dealer's truck from a local branch.

why_ai: Contractors keep the supply house that wins them bids and keeps a job supplied for months, a relationship plus physical logistics that AI assists.
why_clarity: Quotes and releases are defined, but every job differs and which half of a split package was won is learned late or never.
why_digital: Plans, specs and quotes are digital; the deliverable is material on a jobsite, sold through regional contractor relationships.

why_ai: Contractors ask for good applications people by name, but schedule extraction and cross-brand re-selection from performance tables are what document and retrieval models now do.
why_clarity: A compliant re-selection is checkable against the schedule, but accessory and approval judgement is tacit and submittal outcomes arrive weeks later.
why_digital: Bid packages in, priced selections and submittals out, entirely on screen, sold through contractor relationships in a region.

why_ai: Pricing a hold against copper and PVC is a modelling task; only the negotiation with contractors and manufacturers keeps a person in it.
why_clarity: Margin at release is measured line by line within months, and the inputs are public references and price sheets.
why_digital: Price sheets, commodity data and quotes are digital; releases ship physical pipe but the pricing work is on screen.

why_ai: A technician at the counter wants the part in hand now from someone who knows old equipment, which keeps the branch and its veteran central even as lookups automate.
why_clarity: The right part is confirmed when the unit runs or the part comes back, within days, though identification habits are tacit.
why_digital: Requests increasingly arrive by text and photo, but the part is handed over in person at a local branch.

why_ai: Homeowners and designers choose finishes in person with a consultant they trust, and the selection conversation resists automation even as compatibility checks automate.
why_clarity: Compatibility errors surface at rough-in within weeks, but taste and the selection itself have no single right answer.
why_digital: Selections are made face to face in a showroom and delivered as physical fixtures to a local plumber.

why_ai: The owner's relationships with local contractors are the asset, and the physical branch and delivery stay, though order intake and lookups automate.
why_clarity: Kept daily orders and answered questions are countable within weeks, and the work recurs daily.
why_digital: Orders arrive by phone and text and goods leave a local counter, with little digital channel today.

why_ai: Retrofit selection under changing refrigerant rules is high-stakes judgement delivered by a trusted specialist to technicians on emergency calls.
why_clarity: A retrofit works or fails on start-up and compliance is checkable against rules, though choices vary with each system's history.
why_digital: Questions come by phone and counter visit and the product is physical equipment and refrigerant from a local branch.

why_ai: Every check is a lookup against published match, efficiency, refrigerant and rebate tables, which software does directly.
why_clarity: A proposal is right or wrong against the AHRI directory and the rules, instantly.
why_digital: Dealer requests and proposals are digital end to end, sold through distributor platforms.

why_ai: Claim filing is rule-based data entry against each manufacturer's terms; only handling the failed parts keeps it partly physical.
why_clarity: Claims are paid or rejected with a reason code within weeks, in high volume.
why_digital: Claims are filed in portals from photos and tickets, while failed parts sit in branch back rooms.

why_ai: Buyers pay for an agency's reputation and methodology, and assessments built from reporter judgement resist automation, though the litigation shows the risk in one dominant report.
why_clarity: Assessments follow published methodologies weekly, but whether a number reflected the market is contested.
why_digital: Reporter calls in, weekly assessments out, sold by online subscription.

why_ai: Forecasts and share estimates blend interviews and judgement that clients still buy from named analysts, though models assemble public data cheaply.
why_clarity: Forecasts are graded only when later shipment data arrives, and studies vary by client.
why_digital: Interviews and data in, reports out, sold remotely.

why_ai: Member trust and vendor negotiation hold the group together; the analytics are a member service rather than a product.
why_clarity: Benchmarks and rebate calculations are defined, but programme value is judged loosely over years.
why_digital: Member data and catalogues are digital, while membership and buying shows are relationship-driven.

why_ai: Consumer underwriting is heavily automated; regulation and lending capital, not the analysts, sustain the lenders.
why_clarity: Credit models are scored against repayment within months to years on large loan books.
why_digital: Applications, decisions and funding are digital, sold through dealer programmes.

why_ai: Deal judgement and integration leadership stay human, though screening and synergy models automate.
why_clarity: Integration results are visible over years and every deal differs.
why_digital: Financials and data rooms are digital, while deals turn on relationships with owners.

why_ai: Allocation during shortages is negotiated with distributors, but the sell-through analysis behind it is routine analytics.
why_clarity: Programme and allocation results show within a season, though each transition differs.
why_digital: Channel data and programmes are digital, with relationships managed through territory managers.

why_ai: Aggregating member submissions is routine, but members trust the association with confidential data, which sustains it.
why_clarity: Monthly series follow fixed definitions and are checked against members' submissions.
why_digital: Data in and statistics out digitally, governed by association membership.

why_ai: Rulemaking carries statutory authority and accountable officials, and its demand grows with the HFC phasedown.
why_clarity: Rules follow administrative procedure, but each rulemaking is distinct and its effect shows over years.
why_digital: Analysis and rules are documents, but the buyer is a single state agency.

why_ai: Leak-rate calculation and record-keeping are rule-based processing that software increasingly does directly.
why_clarity: Leak rates and deadlines are defined by regulation and checked per appliance.
why_digital: Service records in, compliance reports out, sold remotely to multi-site owners.

why_ai: Recovering and reclaiming refrigerant is plant work under purity standards, and demand rises as virgin supply falls.
why_clarity: Purity is tested against a standard, while trading decisions vary with allowances.
why_digital: Cylinders move physically through counters and plants, with sales arranged remotely.

why_ai: Certification is required by EPA, which sustains demand, but exam delivery is routine and proctoring is the only physical step.
why_clarity: Exams are pass or fail against a fixed bank.
why_digital: Training and exams are largely online, with proctored sessions at branches.

why_ai: News aggregation and rankings from self-reported data are easily produced by AI; relationships with sources are the remaining moat.
why_clarity: Rankings follow simple rules, but editorial quality has no objective check.
why_digital: Entirely digital publishing funded by advertising and events.

why_ai: Load and selection calculations follow published methods that software already performs; manufacturers' data access sustains the publishers.
why_clarity: Calculations follow ACCA methods and are checkable against them.
why_digital: Software sold and updated online to contractors, engineers and distributors.
